result.instructions: Tools for Runn, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who is over-allocated next week, and on which projects?"; "How many billable hours did each person log on the Acme project last month?"; "Show every project with a budget that ends this quarter.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Runn data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run runn_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run runn_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run runn_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. runn_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: runn_get_me
tools.title: Get the Runn account
tools.description: Return the Runn account that the API token belongs to. Use it first to check the connection. Runn API: GET /me/.

tools.name: runn_list_people
tools.title: List people
tools.description: List the people (resources) in the Runn account, with team, tags and skills. Filter by email, name or external id. Runn API: GET /people/.

external_id.description: Filter by the external id from another system.

tools.title: Get a person
tools.description: Return one person by id: name, email, team, tags, skills and custom fields. Runn API: GET /people/{personId}.

tools.name: runn_list_person_leave
tools.title: List a person's leave
tools.description: List the leave (time off) records of one person. Runn API: GET /people/{personId}/time-offs/leave.

tools.title: List logged time
tools.description: List actuals: the hours people logged (timesheets), split into billable and nonbillable minutes, per person, project, role and day. Runn API: GET /actuals/.

tools.name: runn_create_assignment
tools.title: Create an assignment
tools.description: Plan work: assign one person to one project in one role, for a date range, with minutes per day (max 1440). Creates a new assignment each call; it does not check for overlaps first. Runn API: POST /assignments/.

role_id.description: The role for this assignment (from runn_list_assignments or Runn's role list).

phase_id.description: Project phase id, if the assignment belongs to one.

is_billable.description: Whether the planned time is billable.

tools.name: runn_log_time
tools.title: Log time
tools.description: Log hours that one person worked on one project, in one role, on one day. Runn adds the minutes to the matching actual or creates one; each call adds more time. Runn API: POST /actuals/time-entry.

billable_minutes.description: Billable minutes to add (0 if none).

nonbillable_minutes.description: Nonbillable minutes to add (0 if none).

phase_id.description: Project phase id, if the work belongs to one.

workstream_id.description: Workstream id, if the work belongs to one.
